note: Re-judged 2026-11-20 by an independent agent after the tag set moved (d5f71bb580, 2dd2252506): engine/rfc7296_ecn_test.go is gone, rfc7296_ecn_linux_test.go is untagged, and the row is now carried by TestEcnKernelStoresTunnelSAWithoutNoECN, TestRFC7296BareESPOnTemplatedSAKeepsTheOuterCE and the VPP message units. RFC 7296 Section 2.24: "tunnel encapsulators and decapsulators for all tunnel mode SAs created by IKEv2 MUST support the ECN full-functionality option for tunnels specified in [ECN]". The positive installs a tunnel ESP state through xfrmBackend.InstallSA in a private namespace, dumps the SAD over raw netlink and decodes the stored xfrm_usersa_info: mode tunnel, XFRM_STATE_AF_UNSPEC set (proving the octet is Ze's) and XFRM_STATE_NOECN clear, the flag under which Linux skips the ECN step on encapsulation and decapsulation; its documented mutant sets NOECN in the serializer and goes red. The VPP positive asserts ENCAP_COPY_ECN and DECAP_COPY_ECN in the SAD message sent. The negative is on the decapsulated packet: a fragmented bare ESP datagram with outer ECT(0) around an ECN-capable inner packet arrives with inner TOS 0x02, so the CE the positive row of the same test delivers comes from the outer header and is not set unconditionally; the VPP negative shows a refused SA sends no message. Verdict stands.
